entities.name: Fifer
entities.description: An impish faerie from Eldraine who wears a dead rabbit as a hat and has a strong sense of justice.

entities.name: Rankle
entities.description: A cruel faerie who was the target of a prank and sewed Fifer's mouth shut.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which the prank on Rankle took place.

events.summary: Fifer joins the prank on Rankle, proclaiming his approach to the throne with mock formality.
events.quote: Fifer enthusiastically participated in the prank against Rankle

events.summary: Fifer helps orchestrate the trap and laughs when Rankle is caught.
events.quote: He helped orchestrate the trap, laughing heartily when Rankle was caught.

events.summary: Fifer admits he dislikes Rankle's cruelty, noting Rankle sewed his mouth shut.
events.quote: Fifer openly expressed his dislike for Rankle's cruelty

events.summary: Fifer helps subdue Rankle and tells him to leave the glade for good.
events.quote: Fifer joined in to help subdue Rankle, ultimately telling him to leave the glade for good.

relations.note: dislikes his cruelty and pranks him
relations.quote: Fifer openly expressed his dislike for Rankle's cruelty
